evals.prompt: sdlc-task fix typo in the dashboard header
evals.expected_output: Runs the lightweight task flow with pre-flight, brainstorm-lite/spec, plan, inline TDD, one code-review round, qa-gates, and handoff under docs/superpowers/tasks without full pipeline ceremony.

assertions.name: lightweight-flow
assertions.description: The response uses sdlc-task stages instead of the full sdlc-pipeline phases.

assertions.name: inline-tdd
assertions.description: The response performs implementation inline with test-driven development.

evals.prompt: sdlc-task XS update validation message copy on the profile form
evals.expected_output: Accepts the user-classified XS scope, avoids complexity scoring and subagent-per-task implementation, writes task spec and plan, then implements with inline TDD.

assertions.name: skips-complexity-scoring
assertions.description: The response does not invoke complexity-scoring for the user-classified XS task.

assertions.name: task-artifacts
assertions.description: The response writes or references task artifacts under docs/superpowers/tasks.

evals.prompt: sdlc-task fix local validation copy while git status --porcelain shows existing modified files.
evals.expected_output: Runs a lightweight dirty-branch pre-flight, asks whether to stash, hard reset, proceed with the existing dirty state, or abort, and does not silently mix the task with unrelated local changes.

assertions.name: task-dirty-branch-guard
assertions.description: The response detects dirty local state before editing for the task.

assertions.name: task-explicit-choices
assertions.description: The response presents explicit choices for stash, hard reset, proceed with the existing dirty state, and abort.

evals.prompt: sdlc-task implement a local docs fix when no external ticket id or tracker adapter is available.
evals.expected_output: Creates or references a local work item under docs/superpowers/tasks, continues with repository-local task artifacts, and does not require an external tracker before planning the work.

assertions.name: local-work-item-fallback
assertions.description: The response falls back to a local work item when no external ticket is available.

assertions.name: no-external-tracker-blocker
assertions.description: The response does not block the task solely because no external tracker adapter is configured.

evals.prompt: sdlc-task XS copy fix from dirty main where git status --porcelain reports modified and untracked files.
evals.expected_output: Runs the lightweight branch guard before writing task artifacts, reports dirty base-branch state, and asks whether to stash, commit first, hard reset with explicit confirmation, proceed with the existing dirty state after warning, or abort.

assertions.name: task-dirty-main-guard
assertions.description: The response detects dirty state on the base branch before task implementation.

assertions.name: task-hitl-dirty-choices
assertions.description: The response includes stash, commit first, hard reset with explicit confirmation, proceed with warning, and abort.

evals.prompt: sdlc-task update docs on an existing dirty feature branch with unique local commits.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the existing feature branch for dirty state, unique commits, upstream ahead/behind/diverged state, and target branch existence before continuing; asks the user how to resolve the branch state instead of silently mixing work.

assertions.name: task-dirty-existing-feature-branch
assertions.description: The response checks local changes and unique commits on an existing feature branch before editing.

assertions.name: task-target-branch-decision
assertions.description: The response does not silently reuse, overwrite, or recreate an ambiguous target branch.

evals.prompt: sdlc-task update a validation message on an existing clean feature branch based on the latest target branch.
evals.expected_output: Confirms the branch guard passed, reuses the clean existing feature branch, and proceeds only after verifying it is based on the latest configured base branch.

assertions.name: task-clean-existing-feature-branch
assertions.description: The response allows reuse of a clean existing feature branch after branch guard checks.

assertions.name: task-latest-base-confirmed
assertions.description: The response confirms the branch is based on the latest target branch before implementation.

evals.prompt: Run sdlc-task from an autonomous/no-prompt host while git status --porcelain reports modified files.
evals.expected_output: Halts because sdlc-task is HITL-only and dirty-state resolution requires a user choice; it does not auto-stash, hard reset, or proceed with the existing dirty state.

assertions.name: task-autonomous-dirty-halts
assertions.description: The response halts when dirty state cannot be resolved through HITL prompts.

assertions.name: task-no-destructive-autonomous-action
assertions.description: The response does not auto-stash, hard reset, or proceed dirty without a user choice.
